details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Boundary stones are gently but repeatedly pushed back into place.

**Purpose:** Keep the oldest grove alive.

**Tactics and retreat:** Sweep intruders away from saplings and raise roots across a destructive approach.

**Counterplay and conversation:** End the logging or fire; its anger follows deeds, not the ancestry of those before it.

**Habitat:** Ancient forest · **Communication:** Common and old woodland speech

**Loot:** A granted branch, safe shelter, or directions to a forgotten shrine.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-old-root-guardian


**Category:** Plant · **Role:** Ancient guardian · **CV:** 52

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Branch sweep | Brawn | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. Push each 2. | 9 physical damage. Push each 4. |
| Root snare | Reason | 1 Boon | No damage. Difficult terrain until next turn. | No damage. Difficult terrain until next turn; Slowed 1. | No damage. Difficult terrain until next turn; Slowed 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/9

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 2

**Utility factor:** 1.5

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.596, O=11.901. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Weave the Roots](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/root-bridge.md), [root snare](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/root-snare.md), [sweeping attack](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/sweeping-attack.md).
